comment: Advisories the dependency gate tolerates, each with its reason and date. An entry here is a RECORDED DEVIATION, not a silence -- scripts/audit-gate.ts prints every tolerated advisory on every run so the list cannot rot unseen. Remove an entry the moment its reason stops being true.

allow.reason: Prototype pollution in SheetJS. No fixed version exists on the npm registry at any version -- the fixed releases are distributed only from SheetJS's own CDN. xlsx is used for operator-triggered report exports, never to parse files from untrusted sources.
ReDoS in SheetJS. Same situation as above: no npm fix exists; export-only usage on operator-supplied data.

Stack-exhaustion DoS from deeply nested glob patterns. No fixed version exists: 3.0.3 is the latest release and is affected. It is reached only through lint tooling (eslint-config-next -> @next/eslint-plugin-next -> fast-glob -> micromatch); `npm ls braces --omit=dev` is empty, so nothing that ships or serves requests loads it, and the patterns it expands are the repository's own lint globs. Remove when braces publishes a fix or eslint-config-next drops fast-glob.
